data.current_summary: Long-poll for new recognition events on a category.
data.current_description:
Long-polls for new recognition events. The category can be derived
locally from the api_token + radio_id, or read from the
`longpoll_category` field of `getStreams`.

**Important DX caveat:** when no callback URL is configured for the
account (which the server signals via error #19 from `getCallbackUrl`),
longpoll silently returns timeout responses forever — events never
fire. Every official SDK preflights `getCallbackUrl` and raises a
descriptive error if no callback URL is set. The check is bypassable
via a `skip_callback_check` flag.
data.description_suggestion: Long-polls for new recognition events on a stream category. Requires the longpoll_category identifier (derived from api_token + radio_id, or retrieved from getStreams). Returns recognition results as they occur, or timeout responses if no events are available. **Important:** If no callback URL is configured for the account, longpoll will silently return timeout responses indefinitely without firing events. Use getCallbackUrl to verify callback configuration before relying on longpoll, or set skip_callback_check=true to bypass this check.

data.current_summary: Recognize music in large audio/video files (hours- or days-long).
data.current_description:
Enterprise endpoint. Send an HTTPS URL or a multipart file (streamed,
no in-memory buffering needed). The endpoint chunks the audio into
12-second segments and counts each scanned chunk as 1 request.

SDKs default to a 1-hour read timeout for this endpoint and enable TCP
keepalive on the transport.
data.description_suggestion: Enterprise endpoint for music recognition in large audio/video files (hours or days in duration). Accepts either an HTTPS URL or multipart file upload (streamed without in-memory buffering). The endpoint automatically chunks audio into 12-second segments, with each segment counted as one recognition request. Returns recognition results for matched songs found throughout the file. Recommended read timeout is 1 hour with TCP keepalive enabled for reliable long-running operations.
